text:
jia: heads-up — we rolled the new fp8 kernel into shadow for atlas-13b on H100 and L40S for an 8h run. latency down ~12% p95 but seeing small quality deltas on long-context tests :eyes:
sam: numbers? how small is small?
jia: quick summary from longctx-suite (200 samples, prompts up to 8k):
```
base fp16    ppl: 12.3  EM: 78.4
fp8 kernel   ppl: 12.7  EM: 76.8  (ppl +3.3%, EM -1.6 pts)
AWQ-int8     ppl: 12.4  EM: 77.9  (ppl +0.8%, EM -0.5)
```
leo: is that AWQ or GPTQ results? fp8 path details?
jia: fp8 is our new mixed-precision kernel (per-channel scale, exponent bias trick) — not AWQ/GPTQ. AWQ-int8 numbers above are from the int8 baseline run Tara did last week.
tara: AWQ-int8 on same weights + our runtime routing gave ~1% perf hit vs fp16 but no EM regression on long prefixes. FP8 shows better throughput but has edge-case drift with long KV chains on L40S.
leo: can you paste the failing log snippet?
jia: log excerpt from L40S shard during longprefix case:
```
[2026-03-18T22:14:02Z] kv_tile_mismatch: tile_len=1024 kv_seq=8192 -> fallback triggered kernel_swap to fp16
[2026-03-18T22:14:02Z] activation_scale_saturation: layer=24 scale=1.2e4 clipped=true
```
irene: that looks like tiling + activation saturation. we saw similar with fp8 on H100 if the sequence distribution skews long. fallback policy should route >2048 prefixes to fp16. canary that?
sam: +1 for routing rule. start canary 1% traffic to fp8, route prefixes >2048 to fp16. add alert if EM drop >1.0 or ppl delta >2.5%.
jia: running the canary config now — command used to bake:
```
redwood deploy canary --model atlas-13b --variant fp8-kernel --routes "prefix_len<=2048" --traffic 0.01 --timeout 2h
```
eval-bot: automated eval run completed (canary id 2026-03-18-fp8-roll):
- shortctx suite: EM delta 0.0, ppl +0.2%
- longctx suite: EM delta -1.4, ppl +2.9%
- safety checks: ok
link: https://console.redwood/evals/2026-03-18-fp8-roll (internal)

deploy-bot: shadow pool h100-shadow-2 started 8 instances, l40s-shadow-1 started 6 instances.

tara: suggestion: also run a GPTQ stash (low-rank folding) + AWQ hybrid on the same eval set — that will give us a 3-way comparison (fp16, fp8, awq/gptq-int8). keep the eval prompts identical.

sam: agreed. schedule a 12h bake with AWQ and GPTQ variants and collect token-level drift and per-route tail latency.
jia: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/fp8-rollforward/2966012345.tar.gz (contains raw traces, perf profiles, eval results). :thumbsup:
ire ne: will add a short runbook: if EM drop >1.5% for 30m rollback to previous fp16 variant and open incident channel #incidents.
sam: created ticket INF-2319 to track rollout + follow-ups.
leo: FYI i'll dig into the saturation math — might be a per-layer clamp tweak or scale annealing during kv-accum. will ping with a micro patch.
jia: thanks — let's keep this thread for triage notes. planning a sync after the 12h bake.
